tldr: Sun in the 8th house: identity becomes personal through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
body:
With the Sun in the 8th house, this part of you develops through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to what you share, owe, merge with, grieve, fear, desire, or struggle to control.

When this placement is supported, you can become more honest about trust, attachment, and what is actually shared. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, control, secrecy, or fear can make closeness feel heavier than it needs to be. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
